cards.name: Charmander
cards.description: From the time it is born, a flame burns at the tip of its tail. Its life would end if the flame were to go out.

cards.name: Heatmor
cards.description: It draws in air through its tail, transforms it into fire, and uses it like a tongue. It melts Durant and eats them.

cards.name: Litten
cards.description: While grooming itself, it builds up fur inside its stomach. It sets the fur alight and spews fiery attacks, which change based on how it coughs.

cards.name: Salandit
cards.description: Volcanoes or dry, craggy places are its home. It emanates a sweet-smelling poisonous gas that attracts bug Pokémon, then attacks them.

cards.name: Salazzle
cards.description: Filled with pheromones, its poisonous gas can be diluted to use in the production of luscious perfumes.

cards.name: Horsea
cards.description: It makes its nest in the shade of corals. If it senses danger, it spits murky ink and flees.

cards.name: Horsea
cards.description: It makes its nest in the shade of corals. If it senses danger, it spits murky ink and flees.

cards.name: Seadra
cards.description: It is capable of swimming backwards by rapidly flapping its winglike pectoral fins and stout tail.

cards.name: Magikarp
cards.description: Its reckless leaps make it easy pickings for predators. On the bright side, many Pokémon enjoy longer life spans, thanks to Magikarp.

cards.name: Charmeleon
cards.description: When it swings its burning tail, it elevates the air temperature to unbearably high levels.

cards.name: Gyarados
cards.description: There are people who swear that any place Gyarados appears is fated for destruction.

cards.name: Lapras
cards.description: These Pokémon were once near extinction due to poaching. Following protective regulations, there is now an overabundance of them.

cards.name: Totodile
cards.description: Its powerful, well-developed jaws are capable of crushing anything. Even its Trainer must be careful.

cards.name: Croconaw
cards.description: Once it bites down, it won't let go until it loses its fangs. New fangs quickly grow into place.

cards.name: Feraligatr
cards.description: When it bites with its massive and powerful jaws, it shakes its head and savagely tears its victim up.

cards.name: Wooper
cards.description: When the temperature cools in the evening, they emerge from water to seek food along the shore.

cards.name: Quagsire
cards.description: This carefree Pokémon has an easygoing nature. While swimming, it always bumps into boat hulls.

cards.name: Corsola
cards.description: Pursued by Mareanie for the branches on its head, this Pokémon will sometimes snap its own branches off as a diversion while it escapes.

cards.name: Feebas
cards.description: Although unattractive and unpopular, this Pokémon's marvelous vitality has made it a subject of research.

cards.name: Milotic
cards.description: It lives at the bottom of clear lakes. In times of war, it shows itself, which soothes people's minds and hearts.

cards.name: Charizard
cards.description: Its wings can carry this Pokémon close to an altitude of 4,600 feet. It blows out fire at very high temperatures.

cards.name: Phione
cards.description: It drifts in warm seas. It always returns to where it was born, no matter how far it may have drifted.

cards.name: Wishiwashi
cards.description: It's awfully weak and notably tasty, so everyone is always out to get it. As it happens, anyone trying to bully it receives a painful lesson.

cards.name: Trapinch
cards.description: As it digs through the sand, its giant jaws crush any rocks that obstruct its path. It builds a funnel-shaped nest.

cards.name: Hydreigon
cards.description: The heads on their arms do not have brains. They use all three heads to consume and destroy everything.

cards.name: Dratini
cards.description: After a 10-hour struggle, a fisherman was able to pull one up and confirm its existence.

cards.name: Dratini
cards.description: After a 10-hour struggle, a fisherman was able to pull one up and confirm its existence.

cards.name: Dragonair
cards.description: From time immemorial, it has been venerated by agricultural peoples as an entity able to control the weather.

cards.name: Vibrava
cards.description: To help make its wings grow, it dissolves quantities of prey in its digestive juices and guzzles them down every day.

cards.name: Flygon
cards.description: This Pokémon hides in the heart of sandstorms it creates and seldom appears where people can see it.

cards.name: Torchic
cards.description: A fire burns inside, so it feels very warm to hug. It launches fireballs of 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit.

cards.name: Altaria
cards.description: On sunny days, it flies freely through the sky and blends into the clouds. It sings in a beautiful soprano.

cards.name: Bagon
cards.description: With its steel-hard stone head, it headbutts indiscriminately. This is because of the stress it feels at being unable to fly.

cards.name: Shelgon
cards.description: They lurk deep within caves—motionless, neither eating nor drinking. Why they don't die is not known.

cards.name: Druddigon
cards.description: It warms its body by absorbing sunlight with its wings. When its body temperature falls, it can no longer move.

cards.name: Zekrom
cards.description: Concealing itself in lightning clouds, it flies throughout the Unova region. It creates electricity in its tail.

cards.name: Kyurem
cards.description: It generates a powerful, freezing energy inside itself, but its body became frozen when the energy leaked out.

cards.name: Zygarde
cards.description: It's thought to be monitoring the ecosystem. There are rumors that even greater power lies hidden within it.

cards.name: Combusken
cards.description: During a battle, the hot flame in its body increases. Its kicks have outstanding destructive power.

cards.name: Turtonator
cards.description: It gushes fire and poisonous gases from its nostrils. Its dung is an explosive substance and can be put to various uses.

cards.name: Drampa
cards.description: This Pokémon is friendly to people and loves children most of all. It comes from deep in the mountains to play with children it likes in town.

cards.name: Jangmo-o
cards.description: They live in mountains where no trace of humans can be detected. Jangmo-o grow little by little as they battle one another.

cards.name: Hakamo-o
cards.description: It sheds and regrows its scales on a continuous basis. The scales become harder and sharper each time they're regrown.

cards.name: Kommo-o
cards.description: Its rigid scales function as offense and defense. In the past, its scales were processed and used to make weapons and other commodities.

cards.name: Kangaskhan
cards.description: The child in its pouch leaves home after roughly three years. That is the only time the mother is heard to cry wildly.

cards.name: Swablu
cards.description: It constantly grooms its cotton-like wings. It takes a shower to clean itself if it becomes dirty.

cards.name: Swablu
cards.description: It constantly grooms its cotton-like wings. It takes a shower to clean itself if it becomes dirty.

cards.name: Blaziken
cards.description: When facing a tough foe, it looses flames from its wrists. Its powerful legs let it jump clear over buildings.

cards.name: Victini ◇
cards.description: When it shares the infinite energy it creates, that being's entire body will be overflowing with power.

cards.name: Darumaka
cards.description: When it sleeps, it pulls its limbs into its body and its internal fire goes down to 1,100 degrees Fahrenheit.

cards.name: Darmanitan
cards.description: Its internal fire burns at 2,500 degrees Fahrenheit, making enough power that it can destroy a dump truck with one punch.
